evidence: Carries the 'Build system' label and modifies CMakeLists.txt to swap `-Wunreachable-code` for `-Wunreachable-code-aggressive`.
rationale: Enables aggressive unreachable code diagnostics in CMake to catch dead control-flow statements. Enabling compiler warnings improves codebase hygiene across the project, but is reasonably deferrable internal maintenance with no direct user or release integrity impact.
